_about: Places listed first in the Family budget card on the Pay & Prices tab. 'area' must match an EPI metro name exactly (the Areaname column of EPI's Metro sheet) and 'st' its state; for a county, give 'county' and 'st' instead. Edit freely; the next data refresh copies this list into data/fbc.json.
